deal_stage: Technical proposal under review by the purchasing committee
pitch_summary: Multi-agent Gen AI platform to automate denial-of-claims analysis and the billing cycle between network hospitals and health insurers — including post-merger integration with SulAmérica — replacing most of the manual medical-bill audit triage with human supervision on exceptions.
proposed_solution: Agentic pipeline on Azure with medical-record/bill-reading agents, cross-referencing against per-insurer contract rules, and prioritization of recurring claim denials. 22-week implementation, US$720k in Year 1 (license + services).

ceo: Paulo Moll is CEO of Rede D'Or São Luiz and recently received the 2026 Executive of Value Award in the Healthcare category
In his award acceptance speech, he referenced leading roughly 80,000 employees at the company
Under the controlling group's leadership (the Moll family), the network continues investing in higher-education expansion, with 2026 authorization to launch the IDOR School of Medicine

The company completed its merger with SulAmérica, approved by Cade and ANS, with a governance structure in which the CEOs of the new insurance/life units report directly to Rede D'Or — whose executive chairman is Paulo Moll and whose board chairman is Jorge Moll Filho

The network has 30 hospitals in the 2026 world's-best-hospitals ranking (Newsweek/World's Best Hospitals), with a high technology standard even in units outside state capitals (Da Vinci X robotic surgery, advanced hemodynamics centers)

Given this track record of expansion via complex mergers (SulAmérica) and broad technology standardization, Moll tends to evaluate automation proposals through the lens of 'does this resolve the operational friction of the SulAmérica post-merger integration and scale uniformly across hospitals and insurers, without creating yet another siloed system?'
